about: #1456's fixture (README: The fixture). Each session is its steps, in order: a core attention state, or a reading. A reading has `text`, the words the merge base writes for it (its prefix the one packages/hub/src/status.ts matches), `reworded`, the same reading in other words that share no prefix with the base's and none of the words it matches, and `code`, its closed code (README: Defined here). `expected` is each session's session.state, state/cause, as the merge base 118ec119f reads the record of the base's own words with no codes, run on it and pinned here.
